Pănĭōnĭus , a, um, adj., = Πανιώνιος,
I.of or belonging to all Ionia, sacred to all Ionia, Panionian: “regio omnibus Ionibus sacra et ideo Panionia appellata,” Plin. 5, 29, 31, § 113 : “Apollo,” Vitr. 4, 1 .—
(b). Subst.: Pănĭōnĭum , ii. n., i. q. regio Panionia: “ibi est Panionium, sacra regio, et ob id eo nomine appellata, quod eam communiter Iones colunt,” Mel. 1, 17, 2 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
